route: QDC interactive session: learner-driven adb over an SSH tunnel

qnn_context_binary.role: the compiled program: graphs, weights, quantization
qnn_context_binary.graph_pattern: prompt_ar128 and token_ar1 per context length

qairt.role: the runtime that loads context binaries onto the NPU
qairt.fixed_at: SDK version fixed when the bundle was compiled

geniex.role: the generative-AI interface driving prefill and decode

chipset.role: the silicon the binaries were compiled for
chipset.name: qualcomm-snapdragon-8-elite

runtime_configuration.role: editable settings read when GenieX starts
runtime_configuration.chosen_at: run time, limited by compile-time choices
runtime_configuration.note: -c must name a compiled context length; others fail
